name: transcript-rail-icon-seats
description: transcript icon rail (Option A): every railed transcript row — live thought, compact settled thought, full settled thought, compact live thought Loader, static notification, collapsible notification, steering divider, tool call, folded tool run, and turn failure — seats its leading icon in one 0-24px avatar column above 700px with every row's text (and tool call second line + collapsible notification expanded card) starting on the shared 34px content edge with a 10px speaker gap; below 700px every slot leads its line inline at the content edge with text 34px later, and no seat escapes the turn's box

allowlist..body: Every component module defining .body is prefixed via cssClassPrefixes, so resolved.css emits distinct selectors with no collision.
allowlist..chevron: disclosure and toolcallitem are prefixed via cssClassPrefixes; widgets/chevron keeps bare .chevron.
allowlist..label: loader, thinkblock, steeringitem, and toolrungroup are each prefixed via cssClassPrefixes, so resolved.css has no shared .label selector.
allowlist..summary: disclosure, notificationcard, toolcallitem, and toolrungroup are each prefixed via cssClassPrefixes, so resolved.css has no shared .summary selector.
allowlist..summaryText: thinkblock is prefixed to think-summaryText via cssClassPrefixes, keeping it distinct from styles/surface.module.css's .summaryText.

mutation.declaration: styles/railseat.module.css: @media (min-width: 700px) .gutterPull { margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--speaker-gutter)) } reverted to 0, and thinkblock.module.css .label pull reverted to 0
mutation.note: Verified on 2026-11-25 against all 10 real-module rows: reverting styles/railseat.module.css @media (min-width: 700px) .gutterPull to margin-left: 0 failed desktop alignment immediately on think-settled (slot.left=214.0 vs turn.left=180.0); restoring returned all 10 rows across desktop (920px) and phone (390px) to PASS.
